# LLMS — Public agent orientation for openOODA
File: website/llms.txt

This file is the public LLM manual at https://openooda.org/llms.txt.
The name `.txt` is the llmstxt.org URL. The content follows `.oot` law.
Canonical agent front door: github.com/openOODA/openOODA/anchor.oo.

openOODA is a capability-secure systems language and 5-organization operating
ecosystem. The compiler checks source ahead of time. Privileged work needs an
unforgeable capability token.
Public home: https://openooda.org (static index.html; constellation names cli).

## 1. File law

- Code: `.oo`. Documents: `.oot`.
- Every `.oo` and `.oot` file is at most 256 lines (16-240 lines for tactical components).
- Do not create `.py`, `.js`, `.ts`, `.rb`, or `.pl`.
- Do not create `.sh` except the host scripts named in rules.oot.
- Do not create `.md` except README.md and AGENTS.md.
- Product `.oo` files use a 4-element Academy header: Title, Logline,
  Setup, Beats.
- `.oot` files use a 2-line header: `# Title` and `File:`.

## 2. Read order (governance repo)

Start at `openOODA/anchor.oo`. Then:

1. `rules.oot` — 24 laws. They do not change.
2. `spec.oot` — Tier A high-density language specification sheet.
3. `northstar.oot` — architecture, grammar, AST, type system.
4. `rfcs/anchor.oo` — accepted RFCs, numeric order.
5. `practices/anchor.oo` — 8D red team, OODA workflow, release.

To propose a change, copy `rfcs/0000-template.oot`.

## 3. The 5-Organization Ecosystem & 12 Functional Categories

openOODA separates AI Execution Topology (flat 1-binary-per-repo layout across
5 GitHub Organizations) from Human Browsing Taxonomy (5 Layers x 12 Categories
via `ooda.pkg` `layer=` and `category=` fields):

1. `github.com/openOODA` (Layer 0: Toolchain & Stdlib — 14 repos)
2. `github.com/openOODA-kernel` (Layer 1: Ring-0 Microkernel & Drivers — 16 repos)
3. `github.com/openOODA-OS` (Layer 2: Zero-Root System Daemons & Image Builder — 18 repos)
4. `github.com/openOODA-tools` (Layer 3: Userland CLI / TUI / MCP Suite — 257 repos)
5. `github.com/openOODA-DE` (Layer 4: Capability Wayland Desktop Environment — 20 repos)

12 Functional Category Codes (`category=` in `ooda.pkg`):
`SH` (Shell & Terminal), `FS` (Filesystem & Disk), `DF` (Search, Diff & Patch),
`TX` (Text, Binary & Stream), `DT` (Structured Data & Query), `AR` (Archives & Images),
`NT` (Networking & DNS), `SC` (Security, Crypto & Caps), `PR` (Process, Sched & IPC),
`HW` (Hardware, HAL & Power), `UI` (Desktop, Wayland & UI), `AI` (AI Agents, MCP & HUD).

## 4. Layer 0: openOODA Toolchain (14 repos)

| Repo | Role |
|------|------|
| openOODA | Governance: laws, RFCs, practices, buildbox |
| oodar | C host substrate (`oo_*`, Landlock sandbox, `sys_spawn`/`sys_wait`, `OODA_LISTEN_FD`, PQC, GPU) |
| oodac | Self-hosting compiler (`.oo` -> LLVM IR -> native) |
| std | Standard library, 8 domains |
| ooda | Workflow driver (`ooda` binary) |
| cli | Language CLI driver (`ooda update`, build, fmt, qa) |
| install | apt, dnf, pacman, install.sh |
| opm | Capability-aware package manager |
| catalog | Public package list for `opm search` |
| lsp | Language server |
| mcp | MCP server, 26 tools, flight recorder, crash autopsy |
| tui | Terminal coding harness |
| website | Source for https://openooda.org |
| .github | Org profile and shared workflows |

## 5. Layer 1: openOODA-kernel (16 repos)

NT Executive Object Manager (`Ob`) + seL4 `CSpaceTable` and `CdtTree` in `.oo`:
`ookernel-boot`, `ookernel-hal-x86`, `ookernel-hal-arm64`, `ookernel-hal-riscv`,
`ookernel-ob`, `ookernel-mm`, `ookernel-sched`, `ookernel-ipc`, `ookernel-iommu`,
`ookernel-unikernel`, `oodrv-pci`, `oodrv-virtio`, `oodrv-nvme`, `oodrv-net`,
`oodrv-usb-hid`, `oodrv-display-gop`.

## 6. Layer 2: openOODA-OS (18 repos)

Zero-root capability operating system daemons and MCP-over-IPC system bus:
`ooinit`, `oosvc-mgr`, `oovfs`, `oofs-ext4`, `oofs-tmp`, `oonetd`, `oodnsd`,
`oodevd`, `oosession`, `oopolicyd`, `ooaudiod`, `oopowerd`, `oologd`,
`oosysbus`, `oohealthd`, `ooimage`, `ooaid`, `oorealm`.

## 7. Layer 3: openOODA-tools (257 repos)

Standalone CLI / TUI / MCP utilities across all 12 categories:
- `oosh` (shell), `oogrep` (grep), `oodiff` (diff), `oofind` (find), `oojq` (jq), `ootar` (tar), `ootop` (top), `oote` (theme engine), `oollama` (multimodal inference CLI & MCP toolkit).
- Hub: https://openooda-tools.github.io • Org: github.com/openOODA-tools

## 8. Layer 4: openOODA-DE (20 repos)

Capability-enforced Wayland desktop environment in pure `.oo`:
`oocomp`, `oowm`, `oopanel`, `oolaunch`, `ooportal`, `oowall`, `ooshelf`,
`ootoast`, `oolock`, `ooterm`, `oofiles`, `ootaskmgr`, `oosettings`,
`ooclip`, `ooshot`, `ooagent-hud`, `ooedit`, `ooview`, `oobazaar`, `oocockpit`.

## 9. 26 Capability Tokens

`FsReadCap` `FsWriteCap` `FsCap` `NetCap` `TcpCap` `UdpCap` `BindCap`
`SysCap` `ProcessCap` `EnvCap` `TimeCap` `RandCap` `AllocCap` `ArenaCap`
`ThreadCap` `GpuCap` `FfiCap` `SignCap` `MetricsCap` `CompilerReadCap`
`AudioCap` `CameraCap` `UsbCap` `HidCap` `WindowCap` `FrameCap`.

Pass a borrowed token (`&FsReadCap`). Missing token fails compile
(`E_CAP`) or exits `ERR\tcap\t...`. Zero ambient authority.

## 10. 3-Tier Universal App Compatibility & Store Architecture

1. Tier 1 — Flathub / Bazaar Desktop Store Bridge (`ooportal` + `ooimage` + `oopolicyd`):
   - `ooimage` ingests Flathub OSTree Merkle commits into the immutable content-addressed store.
   - `oopolicyd` translates Flatpak metadata permissions (`sockets=wayland;pulseaudio;network`, `filesystems=...`) 1-to-1 into attenuated capability tokens (`WindowCap`, `FrameCap`, `AudioCap`, `NetConnectCap`, scoped `FsReadCap`).
   - `ooportal` mediates file/URI/screen access via intent-driven capability handles.
2. Tier 2 — Podman-Style Rootless Server Containers (`oocage` + `ooimage` + `oosvc-mgr`):
   - Daemonless, rootless OCI container execution (Bazarr, Sonarr, Plex, Postgres) where each container runs in an isolated `CSpace` over read-only `ooimage` Merkle layers and explicit volume/port capabilities (`FsReadCap`/`FsWriteCap`/`NetBindCap`).
3. Tier 3 — Steam/Proton Gaming Cell + IOMMU-Isolated Windows Anti-Cheat Realm (`WinRealm`):
   - Linux Steam + Proton (`DXVK`/`VKD3D`) runs inside a GPU capability cell (`GpuCap` + `FrameCap` + `AudioCap` + `HidCap`) with zero access to personal files or keys.
   - For kernel anti-cheat Windows games (Destiny 2 / BattlEye `BEDaisy.sys`), `ookernel-iommu` + `oodrv-pci` binds the GPU/NVMe partition to an IOMMU-fenced Windows NT Gaming Realm (`WinRealm` via `ookernel-unikernel`) with vTPM/SMBIOS passthrough from `ookernel-boot`, streaming frames at 144Hz/240Hz via zero-copy shared-memory `FrameCap` (LookingGlass/IVSHMEM ring) directly into a native `oocomp` window while mixing audio via `ooaudiod` and forwarding raw input via `oodrv-usb-hid`.

## 11. 3-Tier Canonical OODA Containers, Multimodal Inference & Kernel Supervision

1. Canonical OODA Containers (`openOODA-OS/ooimage` & `oorealm`):
   - `localhost/ooda-core:latest`: Immutable OODA base runtime (`ooinit` PID 1, `oosvc-mgr`, `oologd`, `oohealthd`, `oopolicyd`, `ooaid`, `oorealm`, `ooimage` + `.oo` userland tools, zero `.py`/`.sh`, Ed25519 verified).
   - `localhost/ooda-buildbox:latest`: 24/7 `.oo`-native compiler & fleet audit container (`oodac` seed + `ooda-loop` + `ooda-fanout`).
   - `localhost/ooda-inference:latest` (`ooda-inference.container` Quadlet): Multimodal GPU inference container (`ooaid --serve` on `:11434` + `oollama` + CUDA `llama-server`).
2. Multimodal Inference Toolkit (`ooaid --serve` + `oollama`) & 7 Inference Upgrades:
   - Dual-GPU MTP speculative decoding (`draft_num_predict 3` on `qwen36-35b-uncensored-1m`), active-active routing across `spotlight` (`100.66.54.24`) and `ringmaster` (`100.88.249.93`) with `zebes` control plane, KV-cache prefix pinning (`cache_prompt: true`), `<think>` budget gating, `.ooda-cache/ai` semantic cache, GBNF grammar enforcement (`ooda-verdict` & `oo-page`), mandatory secret redaction, and 8 multimodal endpoints (Text/Chat, Vision `mmproj`, Embeddings `bge-m3`, Rerank `bge-reranker-v2-m3`, STT `whisper-large-v3`, TTS `kokoro-82m`, Image `invokeai`).
3. Kernel Supervision Stack (`oodar` + `ooinit` + `oosvc-mgr` + `oorealm`):
   - Real non-blocking `oo_sys_spawn`/`oo_sys_wait`/`oo_sys_kill`, zero-downtime `OODA_LISTEN_FD` + `SO_REUSEPORT` socket activation, and kernel `Landlock` + `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` sandboxing.

## 12. Install

```
curl -fsSL https://openooda.org/install.sh | bash
ooda update
```
